theorems.name: Submission.isC1Submanifold_image_ball_of_injOn_closedBall
theorems.statement: ∀ (n p : ℕ) (G : Rn n → Rn p) (x : Rn n) (r : ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ 1 G (Metric.closedBall x r) → Set.InjOn G (Metric.closedBall x r) → (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball x r, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ G z)) → IsC1Submanifold n (G '' Metric.ball x r)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
